nfl.name: NFL
nfl.method: A 6-factor model (Elo rating, starting quarterback, scoring margin, rest, form and home advantage) built from 7,309 games (1999–2026) and tested on seasons it never saw.

epl.name: Premier League
epl.method: A 6-factor model (Elo rating, shot share, form, rest, scoring margin and home advantage) built from 3,470 games (2017–2026) and tested on seasons it never saw.

mlb.name: MLB
mlb.method: A 5-factor model (Elo rating, starting pitchers, scoring margin, rest and home advantage) built from 14,560 games (2021–2026) and tested on seasons it never saw.

nba.name: NBA
nba.method: A 4-factor model (Elo rating, rest, scoring margin and home advantage) built from 6,652 games (2021–2025) and tested on seasons it never saw.

nhl.name: NHL
nhl.method: A 5-factor model (Elo rating, shot share, rest, away team on a back-to-back and home advantage) built from 6,560 games (2021–2025) and tested on seasons it never saw.

cfb.name: College Football
cfb.method: A 4-factor model (Elo rating, scoring margin, form and home advantage) built from 7,628 games (2018–2026) and tested on seasons it never saw.

cbb.name: College Basketball
cbb.method: A 4-factor model (Elo rating, scoring margin, form and home advantage) built from 41,091 games (2019–2025) and tested on seasons it never saw.
